description: Sheldon-class somatotype priors for metabolic rate and fat patterning. Scaffold physiology mapped onto FSOT Biology fold.

ectomorph.name: Ectomorph
ectomorph.description: Linear frame; high relative EE; hard gainer; lower spontaneous fat storage.
ectomorph.notes: Higher baseline dispersal tendency of energy; protect against over-deficit.

mesomorph.name: Mesomorph
mesomorph.description: Athletic frame; balanced EE; high training response and muscle retention.
mesomorph.notes: Best responder to resistance + moderate deficit recomp protocols.

endomorph.name: Endomorph
endomorph.description: Stockier frame; lower relative EE; efficient energy storage; higher insulin response.
endomorph.notes: Prioritize protein, steps/NEAT, resistance, insulin management; α2-stubborn depots matter more.

meso_endo.name: Meso-endomorph hybrid
meso_endo.description: Blend 55% meso / 45% endo — common trained soft look.

ecto_endo.name: Ecto-endomorph hybrid (skinny-fat pattern)
ecto_endo.description: Low muscle, elevated central fat tendency.
